title: charging.charger.faulted.v1
description: Published by Charging when the charger declared it cannot deliver energy per contract (F). Subscribers: AssetOps. Dedup key: chargerId + faultCode while a work order is open (R5).

connectorId.description: Optional: absent when the whole charger faulted

faultCode.description: Ubiquitous language fault code, e.g. GroundFailure (mapped from OCPP errorCode by the ACL)
